title: Meeting Lester Young when he sat in for Cecil Irwin
summary: Young filled in at the Orpheum in Minneapolis.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Guess who sat in for Cecil in Minneapolis?
Lester Young. That's where I first met Lester Young.
No, we played them. Show must go on.
That's where I first met Lester Young.
I'll be darned. I know he was up in Minneapolis about that time.
What'd you think of his playing?
Oh, man, he was murder then. Yeah, boy.
He always had that distinctive style.

I think we just filled out that engagement at the theater there. It was a split week. And I don't know whether it was the Friday, Saturday, Sunday, or whether it was Thursday. It was a split week. I know he finished out the engagement. Three days or four days. Then I think we came home after that.
